title: Why does the price rise when demand rises?

steps.title: The axes
steps.say: Price goes up the side, and quantity goes along the bottom.

ops.text: Why does the price rise when demand rises?

steps.title: Demand
steps.say: Demand slopes down: the higher the price, the less buyers want.

steps.title: Supply
steps.say: Supply slopes up: the higher the price, the more sellers offer.

steps.title: Equilibrium
steps.say: They cross at E: that is the market price and quantity.

steps.title: Demand rises
steps.say: Now demand rises, so the demand curve shifts right. The equilibrium slides up along the supply curve: price and quantity both rise.

steps.title: Try it
steps.say: Your turn: drag the red or the blue curve and watch the equilibrium move. The numbers on the right are worked out by code.
